column1: #mapping_set_title: "COBie 2.4 (BS 1192-4) worksheet model to ifcOWL IFC4 ADD2 crosswalk"

#comment: "Candidate-for-review crosswalk between the COBie worksheet model (lifted; see lift/cobie_to_rdf.py) and ifcOWL IFC4 ADD2. The entity-level skeleton follows the COBie mapping documented in BS 1192-4 and the buildingSMART FM Handover MVD, re-expressed against ifcOWL IRIs; the confidences and the non-mappings are this repository's. Rows with predicate_modifier=Not are asserted NON-mappings. SKOS direction per the SKOS Reference: A skos:narrowMatch B asserts B is the narrower concept. COBie asserts zero disjointness, so no mis-mapping into COBie is reasoner-rejectable; every row here rests on SHACL shape checks and human review only."

column9: comment
The documented COBie anchor: a Contact row is a person-in-role-for-an-organisation, keyed by email. IfcPerson or IfcOrganization alone each lose one half of the pair.

The weakest 'direct' row in COBie, kept honest by the two related rows below: one Facility row deliberately flattens three IFC entities (project, site, building) into one record. IfcBuilding is the primary carrier of the facility name in the documented mapping.
The project-context slice of the Facility flattening: units, phase and project name come from IfcProject.
The site slice of the Facility flattening: linear units and site name come from IfcSite.
Direct, with one edge: COBie files roofs and external levels as Floor rows, which IFC represents as storeys only by convention.
Direct. The COBie Space is the managed-location notion and inherits IfcSpace's room-data semantics.

Direct, and the mirror image of the bot-ifc false friend: COBie Zone and IfcZone are both non-spatial aggregations of spaces. The same IFC entity that must NOT be mapped to bot:Zone is exactly right here. Two rows, two crosswalks, opposite verdicts on one label.
The catalogue-specification notion. In practice COBie Types are IfcTypeProduct subtypes (equipment, fittings); IfcTypeObject is the documented superclass target.
The installed occurrence. Strictly the MVD admits some non-element products as components; IfcElement covers the maintainable-asset core that COBie exists for.
Direct. IFC4 refines this with IfcDistributionSystem and IfcBuildingSystem subclasses; COBie keeps one flat sheet.

The documented target is the aggregation relationship, not a thing: a COBie Assembly row reifies an IfcRelAggregates (or nesting) instance. IfcElementAssembly is the related first-class object when the aggregation is itself a product.
The object-side reading of the row above, applicable when the assembly is modelled as a product rather than a relationship.
Direct: both reify a logical connection between two components.
The documented target: a spare part is a product-typed construction resource.
COBie Resource spans materials, tools and training, which is the IfcConstructionResource family (product, equipment, material, labour subtypes), not any single leaf.
Maintenance, operation and safety procedures are IfcTask instances in the handover MVD (IfcProcedure carries the step-level detail).
Direct: a Document row is a named external reference applying to another row, which is IfcDocumentInformation's exact remit, and both sides key on name plus location rather than content.

A COBie Attribute row is a named single value on another row, which is precisely IfcPropertySingleValue. The broader IfcProperty admits enumerated, bounded and table values that COBie's one-column shape cannot carry.

The documented but weakest target: BS 1192-4 routes issues through approval records. An Issue row (risk, clash, observation between two rows) and an IfcApproval (a sanctioned decision) overlap without either subsuming the other. Flagged low-confidence deliberately.

Asserted non-mapping at the entity level: a Coordinate row is a projection of geometry (a point, line or box derived from placement and representation), not an entity. There is no IFC4 class whose instances are COBie coordinates; mapping it to any product or placement class confuses a derived view with a thing. The honest statement is that this sheet crosswalks to a computation over IfcLocalPlacement and representation, not to a class.

Asserted non-mapping: IFC4 ADD2 has no entity for economic or environmental impact; in practice impacts land in ad-hoc property sets. A property set is a carrier, not a concept, and asserting the mapping would make any property set an impact. The gap is real and belongs in the record.
